say:2:1030101002:0.text: Sorry. We've just arrived in Northville from Holistone.
say:2:1030101002:0.source_cn: 抱歉。我们刚刚从圣石镇加派到北村。
say:2:1030101002:0.male: Sorry. We've just arrived in Northville from Holistone.
say:2:1030101002:0.female: Sorry. We've just arrived in Northville from Holistone.

say:3:1030101003:0.text: I don't think we know any more information than you do.
say:3:1030101003:0.source_cn: 对这里的了解并不比你们多。
say:3:1030101003:0.male: I don't think we know any more information than you do.
say:3:1030101003:0.female: I don't think we know any more information than you do.

say:4:1030101004:0.text: We were dispatched here all of a sudden. The situation must be dire. But you have nothing to worry about. The guards of Holistone will bring peace to Ryeham.
say:4:1030101004:0.source_cn: 突然调度我们，意味着这里出现了危险。但不必担心，圣石镇...
